title: Induced EMF calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the induced EMF using Faraday's law with the given slope from the graph.

title: Circuit current determination
description: Essential: Correctly computes the current using Ohm's law for the complete circuit with total resistance R+r.

title: Maximum power condition
description: Important: Identifies that maximum power transfer occurs when the external resistance equals the internal resistance.

title: Maximum power calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the maximum power using the current when R=r and the power formula P=I²R.

title: Faraday's law application
description: Important: Properly applies Faraday's law with the correct number of turns and area to find the rate of change of flux.

title: Graph interpretation
description: Optional: Correctly extracts the rate of change of magnetic field from the provided figure.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and presents final answers with correct units.

title: Incorrect resistance sum
description: Pitfall: Fails to include both internal and external resistances when calculating circuit current.

title: Wrong power transfer condition
description: Pitfall: Assumes maximum power occurs at maximum current or other incorrect conditions instead of R=r.
